## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install llm_context in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure llm_context package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to llm_context
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/radekosmulski/llm_context):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/radekosmulski/llm_context.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/radekosmulski/llm_context)

``` sh
$ conda install -c radekosmulski llm_context
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/llm_context/)

``` sh
$ pip install llm_context
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/radekosmulski/llm_context)’s
[pages](https://radekosmulski.github.io/llm_context/). Additionally you
can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/radekosmulski/llm_context) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/llm_context/) respectively.
